entries.message: This update includes make Up Next reliable across Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin and verify the public documentation against the v1.1.0 release.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Show the right next episode even when it has never been watched, so an episode sitting unwatched in your libraries no longer goes missing from Up Next
Return an episode to Up Next when you mark it unwatched, instead of dropping it from the queue
Mirror Up Next onto Plex Continue Watching, Emby Resume, and Jellyfin Resume so the same queue appears on your media server's own rails
Share Up Next dismissals across every device and browser, and add a dialog to review and restore anything dismissed by mistake
Restore Jellyfin as a full Up Next source for reading, dismissing, playlists, and rails
Stop an Up Next push from reaching the wrong title on a media server that reuses short numeric ids
Add a Main / Alpha toggle to Settings - Changelog, explained in the in-app Release Guide, so any install can read published alpha build notes
Tell alpha and develop installs about a newer build on their own channel as well as a newer published release, and publish changelog bullets in full instead of cutting them off mid-sentence
Mark all 36 documentation pages as verified against the v1.1.0 application baseline, replacing markers that still claimed v1.0.2 while v1.1.0 was live
Show the release changelog, the documentation state, and the running application and website before a release is published, so the exact state being released can be checked first
messageFragments: Feature - Make Up Next reliable across Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin
Docs - Verify the public documentation against the v1.1.0 release
